contract: docs/design/workstation-contract.md (design contract table, content states, target viewports 390x844, 768x1024, 1440x900; also swept at 360, 705 and 1024)

accessibility.evidence: Measured only on the Silicon workstation view with scripts/ws-a11y.mjs (a11y.json, taken before the Board, Matter, Library and Templates surfaces existed): 26 consecutive Tab presses each landed on a visible element with a solid focus outline, the order starts Skip to content, wordmark, workbench tabs, theme toggle, then the rail; computed text contrast over 34-35 elements per state (dark and light) had a minimum of 5.43:1 dark and 5.25:1 light and no failures. The new surfaces reuse the same tokens, buttons and focus style, and every matrix cell, chip and card is a real button with an aria-label, but keyboard order and contrast were NOT re-measured on Board, Matter, Library or Templates, and the STL canvas has only button-based rotation (no keyboard-driven camera beyond the Rotate buttons). Reduced motion, screen readers and forced colours were not exercised. Known limit: the reused event ticker makes every row a tab stop.

responsive.evidence: scripts/ws-gate.mjs (overflow-fx.json, overflow-partial.json, overflow.json): documentElement.scrollWidth equals innerWidth in every capture at 360x780, 390x844, 705x900, 768x1024, 1024x768 and 1440x900 across the Silicon canvas, evidence drawer, agent, project and evidence tabs, Board (matrix, rung evidence, repaired design), Matter (plate, Pareto, matrix, rung evidence), Library with and without an open evidence panel, and Templates. The matrix scrolls inside its own region; grid tracks are minmax(0,1fr) with min-w-0. One real bug was found and fixed by this sweep (the Library evidence panel collapsed to a few characters wide because wide rows spanned two columns of a one-column grid). Long content was checked only with real mnemonics, titles and the real Matter and Board runs; no synthetic long-name test.

loading.evidence: ws-1440x900-loading.png: Silicon replay near its start (baseline only, dashes for unknown numbers, events list growing). The Library loading skeleton rows and the pre-fetch run skeleton exist but were not captured; the agent streaming state is exercised by the server tests with a scripted upstream and live once via curl, not in the browser.

empty.evidence: ws-1440x900-board.png and ws-1440x900-matter.png (no fixtures installed): Board and Matter show 'not built yet' with a Roadmap label when no replay of that domain exists. ws-1440x900-templates.png: 'No templates yet, no manifest installed'. The Agent panel shows 'Agent endpoint not connected yet' with a disabled composer when the server has no key (ws-390x844-agent.png).

error.evidence: Real failure states rendered with real data: ws-1440x900-board-rung-fx.png and ws-1440x900-board-repair-fx.png show a failed B4 (firmware says GPIO12, netlist wires GPIO14) with its detail and cited fact ids in the drawer and no claim label; ws-1440x900-matter-rung-fx.png shows an M3 printability fail and unknown (not pass) M4/M5; ws-1440x900-partial.png shows pruned silicon candidates with reasons. ws-1440x900-templates-fx.png shows a broken template (run not recorded). Not rendered in a browser: agent tool errors and upstream failures (covered by server and reducer tests), a corrupt STL, an unreadable replay in the Library (alert copy exists), run.failed.

partial.evidence: ws-1440x900-partial.png and ws-390x844-partial.png: Silicon replay mid-run (6 candidates, 1 running, best so far, Fmax not measured). Board and Matter canvases were captured only at the end of the replay (t=end); a mid-run Board or Matter state was not captured.

success.evidence: ws-1440x900-default.png, ws-768x1024-default.png, ws-390x844-default.png: completed Silicon replay with evidence chips; ws-1440x900-evidence-open.png: the drawer for the 3.76x speedup. With dev fixtures (real Board and Matter logs, never shipped): ws-1440x900-board-fx.png (all five rungs pass on the repaired design, author-curated notice), ws-1440x900-matter-fx.png (winner n7 with the extruded plate, Pareto, matrix, gallery), ws-1440x900-library-fx.png and ws-1440x900-library-evidence-fx.png (16 verified instructions, evidence panel with tool, run, node, seq and reproduce command).

permission.reason: The per-visitor and daily agent limits exist in /api/agent (HTTP 429 with a plain message, in-memory per instance) and are covered by unit tests, but the limit state was not rendered in the browser because that needs a live key on the served build; it is untested visually. No other surface has an access boundary.
